name: SAM Material Regions
description: Text-prompted segmentation of a tile into material regions (stone, mortar, moss, sand, timber...). The mask becomes a material_id channel, which is what later lets per-material roughness/metallic presets be applied instead of one average material across the whole tile.
setup_notes: SAM3 ships with ComfyUI as the built-in SAM3_Detect node, but no SAM3 weights are installed in this ComfyUI yet, and SAM3_Detect needs both a MODEL and CLIP text conditioning. Install a SAM3 checkpoint, then point node 2 at it and edit the prompt on node 4. Until then this recipe is listed but will not run -- every other recipe works without it.
